author: reek
body: Display integration for the browser. Bridges the UI foreword's Framebuf (in-memory pixel buffer) to the VBE framebuffer (memory-mapped display hardware).

author: reek
body: The UI rendering pipeline produces a Framebuf via render-tree. This module copies the Framebuf contents to the VBE linear framebuffer for display.

author: reek
body: Copy the in-memory Framebuf to the VBE hardware framebuffer. Each pixel in Framebuf is a packed 32-bit XRGB value; VBE expects the same format at the fb-base address.

author: reek
body: Optimized transfer that only writes changed pixels within a bounding rectangle.

author: reek
body: When graphics mode is unavailable, render the browser in text mode using VGA text output.
